name: Online Channel Settings
description: Instagram catalog and WooCommerce store connection.

fields.label: Catalog Feed Token
fields.description: Made automatically. The feed address is shown below; give it to Meta Commerce Manager as a scheduled data feed.

fields.label: Shop Address
fields.description: The web address a catalog item links to when it has no WooCommerce page, for example https://shop.example.ir

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: The secret typed in the WooCommerce webhook. Orders that are not signed with it are refused.

fields.label: Webhook Address
fields.description: WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Webhooks: topic Order created and Order updated, delivery URL this address.

fields.label: Online Warehouse
fields.description: Stock sent to the store and taken by its orders.

fields.label: Price Factor
fields.description: Rials = store price x factor. 1 when the store is in rials, 10 when it is in tomans.

fields.label: Shipping Income Account
fields.description: Empty leaves the shipping charge out of the order total (it is kept in the order note).

fields.label: Run Orders As
fields.description: The user that creates the orders. Empty uses Administrator.
